meta.homeTitle: WallHaze — AI Wallpapers for Every Screen
meta.homeDescription: Create stunning AI wallpapers made for your device. Explore unique styles — anime, cyberpunk, fantasy and more — in high quality for phone, tablet and desktop.
meta.studioDescription: The WallHaze studio: describe your wallpaper, pick a style, choose your device and aspect ratio, add a reference image and generate high-quality AI wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop.
meta.wallpapersDescription: Browse free wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop. Artwork with cleared licensing is downloadable; items still under review are view-only. Every wallpaper has its own detail page.
meta.loginDescription: Sign in to WallHaze to manage your account, Credits and creations. Account services are being prepared and sign-in is not open yet.
meta.signupDescription: Create a WallHaze account to keep your Credits and creations. Account services are being prepared and registration is not open yet.
meta.accountDescription: Your WallHaze account center: profile, settings, Credits and orders. Account services are being prepared.
meta.creditsDescription: WallHaze Credits power AI wallpaper generation. See your real balance, packages and orders in the Credits center.
meta.myCreationsDescription: Your locally saved AI wallpaper generations — stored on this device only, with download and reuse.
meta.aboutDescription: What WallHaze is today: a free AI wallpaper gallery and a Studio for creating your own wallpapers, in seven languages.
meta.faqDescription: Answers about the free gallery, which artwork can be downloaded, the AI Studio, Credits, licensing and local history.
meta.helpDescription: How to use WallHaze: browse the gallery, download cleared artwork, use the Studio, and troubleshoot common issues.
meta.contactDescription: How to reach the WallHaze team. Official contact channels will be published here once they are available.
meta.privacyDescription: How WallHaze handles personal data: accounts, Google sign-in, generated content, Credits, cookies — and how to request access or deletion.
meta.termsDescription: The rules for using WallHaze: the gallery, downloads and licences, community submissions, the AI Studio, Credits and account terms.
meta.communityDescription: Discover static and live wallpapers from independent creators, submitted by email and published after human review.

studio.subtitle: Everything you need to design, generate and collect wallpapers — prompt it, pick a style, dial in the ratio, and save what you love.

popular.title: Browse by style
popular.subtitle: Six signature looks to start from — open any style in the Studio and make it yours.

studioIntro.title: Design it. Generate it. Set it.
studioIntro.body: The Studio is WallHaze’s creative workspace: describe what you want to see, pick a signature style, dial in the exact ratio and resolution for your device — and keep the result in your personal library.
studioIntro.feature1Body: Start from hand-tuned presets — from neon cyberpunk to cozy anime — or write a prompt that’s entirely your own.
studioIntro.feature2Body: Phone, tablet or desktop: choose a device preset, an aspect ratio and a resolution — including one recommended for your current screen.
studioIntro.feature3Body: Attach a subject photo to guide the composition and scene; the Studio previews the result before you save it.
studioIntro.visualAlt: Wallpaper sample preview in a phone frame

why.title: Built differently, on purpose
why.item1Body: From a 9:16 phone lock screen to a 16:9 desktop, wallpapers are composed for the device you actually use.
why.item2Body: Browse a hand-picked gallery with clear labels; cleared artwork can be downloaded without an account.
why.item3Body: Clear labels for what’s live, what’s in review and what needs an account — you always know what you’re looking at.
why.item4Body: The whole experience speaks your language — English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Français and Deutsch.

about.title: About WallHaze
about.intro: WallHaze is an AI wallpaper product for phone, tablet and desktop — a free gallery of ready-made wallpapers plus a Studio for creating your own.
about.whatBody: The gallery offers free, hand-picked AI wallpapers in many styles — anime, cyberpunk, fantasy, nature and more — each with a detail page and, when licensing is cleared, direct download. The Studio lets you create your own wallpaper from a description, style, device and optional reference image.
about.capGalleryBody: Browse and search wallpapers for every screen; cleared artwork can be downloaded without an account.
about.capStudioBody: A complete creation flow — the final generation submit opens together with account and Credits services.
about.capLanguagesBody: The whole site is localized into English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and German.
about.roadmapBody: Account sign-in, the Credits wallet, paid AI generation and cloud-saved creations are planned but not connected yet. Features appear on the site only when their backend services are real.
about.disclaimerBody: This page describes only confirmed capabilities. Company details, team size, user counts and partners are not stated because none have been confirmed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers about the gallery, the Studio, Credits and licensing.
faq.q1Q: How do I use the free gallery?
faq.q1A: Open the Gallery, browse by category or style, or search by name and mood. Every wallpaper has its own detail page — no account is needed.
faq.q2Q: How do I download a wallpaper?
faq.q2A: Use the Download button when it is shown on a card or detail page. Artwork still under licensing review is view-only; cleared artwork saves directly or opens in a new tab if the browser blocks the download.
faq.q3A: The Studio is where you describe a wallpaper in your own words, pick a style, device and aspect ratio, and optionally add a reference image. Submitting requires an account and Credits; when the site is not connected to its services, the Studio says exactly what is missing instead of pretending to generate.
faq.q4A: Credits are WallHaze's prepaid balance for AI generation. Prices and balances only ever come from the WallHaze backend — nothing is simulated or estimated in the browser.
faq.q5Q: Why is generation not open yet?
faq.q5A: Real generation costs money per request, so it is gated behind sign-in, a server-side price and a Credits balance. If any of those cannot be verified, the submit path stays blocked rather than pretending to generate.
faq.q6Q: Can I use the wallpapers commercially?
faq.q6A: The gallery is free to browse. Download is available only for artwork whose licensing review is complete; a public download does not grant a commercial license. Each detail page shows the current status.
faq.q7Q: What is the difference between local history and cloud creations?
faq.q7A: Your generation history is stored only in this browser (up to 20 entries) — it is not backed up, not synced, and clearing browser data removes it. Cloud-stored creations across devices are planned but not available yet.
faq.q8A: Not for the gallery. An account is required for the AI Studio and the Credits wallet; sign-in and registration open with the paid services.

help.title: Help & troubleshooting
help.subtitle: How to use WallHaze and what to do when something misbehaves.
help.startBody: Start in the Gallery: filter by category or style, search by name or mood, and open any wallpaper for details, licensing status and download availability.
help.downloadBody: Press Download when it is available on a card or detail page and the file saves to your device. Artwork under licensing review does not show a download control.
help.studioBody: Describe your wallpaper, pick a style, then choose device, aspect ratio and size. You can attach a reference image (PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB). The final submit step is currently disabled — see the FAQ for why.
help.t1Body: Check your connection and try again. Some browsers block programmatic downloads — the image then opens in a new tab. If the download control is absent, the artwork is still under licensing review.
help.t2Body: Generation history lives in your browser's local storage (max 20 entries). Private browsing, storage cleanup or a cleared cache removes it — this cannot be recovered.
help.t3Title: An image looks broken or expired
help.t3Body: Some generated images are stored at temporary URLs that can expire. The record keeps your prompt and settings, so you can recreate it in the Studio.
help.moreHelpLabel: More questions? Check the FAQ or the Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data WallHaze processes when you visit wallhaze.com or use its services, why, and what choices you have.
privacy.introBody: WallHaze ("WallHaze", "we", "us") operates the website wallhaze.com and its API at api.wallhaze.com — a wallpaper gallery, a community gallery of creator submissions, and an AI Studio for generating wallpapers. This policy applies to the WallHaze website and services. It covers visitors, registered users, and anyone who contacts us or submits a wallpaper by email.
privacy.collectBody: What we process depends on how you use WallHaze:
collectItems: Account data: when you register with email and password, we store your email address, a display name if you set one, your language preference and the account creation date. Your password is stored only as a salted scrypt hash — never in plain text.

Generated content: when you use the AI Studio, we store your prompt, the style and device settings you chose, and the generated image or video in your account. Your on-device generation history (up to 20 entries) and your favorites stay in your browser's local storage and are never sent to a server.
Credits and orders: if you use the Credits wallet, we keep your balance, your credit transactions and, where top-up orders exist, each order and its payment status.
Community submissions: if you submit a wallpaper by email, we receive your email address, your message and the files or links you send. Published works show the author name and links you provided.

Security data: failed sign-in attempts are throttled using a record that combines the attempted email address with the IP address; the record is deleted within 24 hours. WallHaze does not run third-party analytics or advertising trackers.
Your messages: if you email us — for example to report a work or request deletion — we process your message and email address to handle it.
privacy.googleBody: You can sign in with Google. WallHaze requests only the basic identity scopes openid, email and profile. We do not request and cannot access sensitive or restricted Google data — not Gmail, Google Drive, Google Photos, your contacts or any other Google services.
googleItems: What we receive: your Google account ID (a stable identifier), the email address of that Google account and your Google profile name. The email address must already be verified by Google before the sign-in can be used. We do not receive your Google profile picture, contacts or files.
What we use it for: to authenticate you, to create your WallHaze account on first sign-in, to show your display name in your account, and to keep you signed in.

Existing accounts: if you already have a WallHaze account with the same email address, signing in with Google does not merge the two automatically — you sign in with your password and connect Google from your account settings instead.

Your control: you can revoke WallHaze's access at any time in your Google account permissions and disconnect Google in your WallHaze account settings. Revoking access does not by itself delete your WallHaze account — see section 7.
privacy.cookiesBody: WallHaze does not use advertising, tracking or third-party analytics cookies. When you sign in, the API sets a session cookie that is HTTP-only, same-site and marked Secure over HTTPS. It keeps you signed in for up to 30 days or until you sign out, and no session token is ever stored in browser local storage. The Google sign-in flow additionally sets a short-lived (about 10 minutes) HTTP-only state cookie, limited to the OAuth path, to protect the redirect round-trip. Independently of cookies, your browser's local storage keeps device-local data: favorites, generation history and your Studio size preference.
privacy.useBody: We process the data described above to:
useItems: operate WallHaze: accounts and sign-in, the gallery, downloads, the AI Studio, Credits and orders;
keep the service safe: rate limiting, preventing brute-force sign-in attempts, abuse and fraud;
review community submissions, publish them after human review, and handle reports about works;
process credit top-ups and keep order records;
answer questions, reports and requests you send us.
privacy.useNote: We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it to build advertising profiles.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: WallHaze relies on a small number of providers:
thirdPartyItems: Cloudflare — hosting of the website frontend and storage of images (Cloudflare R2).
A hosting provider — runs the API and the PostgreSQL database.
AI model providers — when you request a generation, your prompt and settings are sent to the AI generation service (fal.ai) to create the image or video.
A payment provider (Waffo) — handles checkout if you buy Credits, where payment services are enabled.
Your email provider — submissions, reports and requests reach us by email.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected:
retentionItems: Account data is kept while your account exists.
Sessions are valid for up to 30 days; signing out ends the session server-side.
Failed sign-in throttle records (email and IP) are deleted within 24 hours.
Generated media stored in the cloud is kept for 30 days from creation and then removed; copies you downloaded are not affected.
Processed payment webhook records are deleted after 90 days. Orders and credit transactions are kept as financial records, also after an account is deleted.
Community submission emails are kept as long as needed to review, publish and manage the work.
Browser local data (favorites, history, preferences) stays on your device until you clear it.
You can request deletion of your account and personal data by email; we verify the request and delete the account and its data.
privacy.securityBody: WallHaze uses transport encryption (HTTPS), stores passwords only as salted scrypt hashes, uses HTTP-only session cookies, protects the Google sign-in flow with signed state plus PKCE and nonce validation, applies rate limiting, and isolates account data so creations are only accessible to their owner. No security measure is perfect — we cannot guarantee absolute security, and we encourage you to use a unique password.
privacy.rightsBody: You can review your account data in your account settings, where you can also change your language preference and connect or disconnect Google sign-in. For access, correction or deletion requests — including deleting your account — email us at the address below. Requests are handled manually; we may ask questions to verify that you own the account before acting on a request. Favorites, history and other browser data you can clear yourself at any time.
privacy.childrenBody: WallHaze is not directed at children. We do not knowingly create accounts for, or collect personal data from, children below the minimum age at which they can consent to data processing in their region. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy as WallHaze develops. The current version is always published on this page with its "last updated" date. Significant changes will be announced on the site.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, access or deletion requests, and reports about published works, email xiongfh2000@gmail.com — currently the official WallHaze contact channel.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of wallhaze.com and the WallHaze services. Please read them before using WallHaze.
terms.acceptanceBody: By accessing or using WallHaze — browsing the gallery, downloading wallpapers, submitting work, creating an account or generating images — you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. You must be old enough to have an account under the rules of your region and of the sign-in provider you use.
terms.serviceBody: WallHaze is a wallpaper platform. It offers a curated gallery of static and live wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop, a community gallery of creator submissions published after human review, and an AI Studio where registered users generate wallpapers using Credits. Features may be added, changed or discontinued over time; the pages of the site reflect the services that are currently available.
terms.accountBody: Parts of WallHaze require an account. You are responsible for the accuracy of your sign-in email, for keeping your password and devices secure, and for all activity under your account. Tell us as soon as you notice unauthorized use. Do not share or sell your account, and do not create accounts to circumvent restrictions. We may ask you to verify account ownership before acting on requests.
terms.submissionsBody: Community wallpapers are submitted by email and published only after human review. By submitting, you confirm that you own the work or have the necessary rights, permissions and releases for it, and that publishing it on WallHaze does not violate any law or third-party right. You grant WallHaze the non-exclusive right to host, adapt for display and publish the submitted work on the site, together with the author name and links you provide. You keep ownership of your work. Submissions may be declined; sending one does not create a right to publication. You can ask us to remove a published work at any time.
terms.ipBody: The WallHaze name, site design, code and original copy are protected by intellectual-property law. Gallery and community artwork remains the property of its creators or rights holders. Each work's detail page shows its source and licence status — consult that page before any use beyond setting the image as a wallpaper.
terms.downloadsBody: A download button appears only for works whose rights review is complete and whose creators allow downloading. Downloading a work grants exactly the permission stated on its detail page — for example personal device use, or a CC0 licence whose attribution and commercial-use terms apply as written. If a page shows no download control, the work is view-only and may not be copied, redistributed or republished. Unless a work's licence explicitly says otherwise, a download is not a commercial licence.
terms.prohibitedBody: When using WallHaze you must not:
prohibitedItems: break the law or the rights of others, including copyright, portrait and trademark rights;
submit or generate unlawful, infringing or harmful content, including content that exploits or endangers minors;
attempt to bypass rate limits, security measures or access controls, or access data that is not yours;
scrape, bulk-download or redistribute the catalogue in a way that circumvents the per-work permissions;
interfere with the operation of the service or impose unreasonable load on it;
misrepresent your identity or the rights you hold to a submitted work.
terms.aiBody: Generations are produced by third-party AI model services from the prompt and settings you provide. Similar prompts can produce similar results; we do not promise that a generation is unique or free of resemblance to existing works, and we do not represent that AI output is free of third-party rights. You are responsible for the prompts you enter and for using the results in line with these terms. Generated images and videos are delivered to your account and kept under the retention described in the Privacy Policy; download what you want to keep. Generated wallpapers are currently intended for personal screen use; broader usage rights will be described here if and when they are introduced.
terms.creditsBody: Credits are WallHaze's prepaid balance for AI generation. A generation reserves and consumes Credits according to the price shown before you confirm it. Credits are obtained by purchasing packages — checkout is handled by an external payment provider and opens only where payment services are enabled for the deployment. Package prices are shown at the point of purchase. Credits are tied to your account and cannot be transferred between accounts. If a payment does not result in Credits being added, contact us with your order so we can check it. Refund handling is stated at the point of purchase once payment services are open; no refund promise is made here.
terms.reviewBody: Gallery and community content is reviewed by humans before publication where applicable. We may edit the listing of, restrict, or remove any content that violates these terms, infringes the rights of others or is otherwise objectionable, and we may do so without prior notice. If you believe a work infringes your rights, email us with the work, the link, the problem and supporting evidence; we review every report.
terms.availabilityBody: WallHaze is provided as it is and as available. We do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation; the service may be changed, suspended or discontinued, in whole or in part, at any time. Planned maintenance and infrastructure incidents may interrupt availability.
terms.liabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, WallHaze is provided without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the WallHaze operator is not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, or for loss of data or profits, arising from your use of, or inability to use, the service. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.
terms.terminationBody: We may suspend or terminate an account and remove its access to the service if it violates these terms or the law, if payment fraud is involved, or if the account is used to harm the service or other users. Where practicable we will tell you why. You can stop using WallHaze at any time and request account deletion as described in the Privacy Policy.
